$description: Canonical design tokens for Portion (DTCG 2025.10). Values follow docs/design/visual-direction.md; generated consumers in src/design-system/tokens/generated are derived from this file by scripts/tokens/build.mjs and must never be edited by hand.

ui.$description: The installed @fontsource-variable/inter asset registers 'Inter Variable'; it is the approved Inter typeface.

bold.$description: Active bottom-navigation label only. Rendered from the same Inter Variable file (wght 100-900).

10.$description: Active bottom-navigation label only; never instructions, labels, inputs, errors or nutrition values.

wordmark.$description: Wordmark tracking ratio, authored unitless per DTCG 2025.10 (the dimension type accepts only px or rem, not em). The generator emits this specific token as -0.03em, the approved CSS value, never as px or rem. Wordmark only; never applied to interface text.

caption.$description: 16 px line height at 12 px text (16/12).

nav-label.$description: 14 px line height at 10 px text (14/10).

supporting.$description: 20 px line height at 14 px text (20/14).

body.$description: 24 px line height at 16 px text (24/16).

compact-title.$description: 24 px line height at 18 px text (24/18).

section-title.$description: 28 px line height at 20 px text (28/20).

detail-heading.$description: 32 px line height at 24 px text (32/24).

screen-heading.$description: 36 px line height at 28 px text (36/28).

main-result.$description: 48 px line height at 40 px text (48/40).

full.$description: Exceptional token for true circles only; not a default pill radius.

add-food.$description: The separate circular Log food action's target (56 x 56).

standard.$description: Restrained interface easing; an implementation decision, not a research finding.

disabled.$description: Inactive control text. Visibly lighter than text.secondary; exempt from the text-contrast minimum as an inactive component (WCAG 1.4.3), 3.9:1 on canvas.

secondary-surface.$description: Tinted fill of the secondary button and the text button's hover. Same step as selected-surface; a separate role so a later change to one does not silently restyle the other.

text.$description: Label of a disabled control. 3.2:1 on the disabled surface, 4.0:1 on canvas — inactive components are exempt from the 4.5:1 minimum, and this step is deliberately lighter than text.secondary so a disabled control no longer reads as active.

track.$description: Unfilled portion of a progress bar. A non-essential guide; the fill, the marker and the text carry the meaning.

indicator.$description: Fill of the calorie budget bar: blue as information about progress toward a user-set bound, never a success/error colour; it does not change hue when the goal is reached or exceeded. 3.0:1+ on the track and on the surface.

marker.$description: The goal marker on the calorie budget track: a 2 px neutral tick at the bound, visible over the fill and the track.

boundary.$description: The destination group's hairline; the group's fill and its contents identify it, so the hairline is not an essential boundary.

content.$description: Inactive destination glyphs. 6.1:1 on the group surface.

selected-content.$description: The active destination's bold glyph and 10/14 label. 5.4:1 on the selected surface.

action-surface.$description: The separate circular Log food action — the one filled element in the bar.

action-content.$description: The Log food glyph. 6.2:1 on the action surface.

wordmark.$description: The lowercase portion wordmark in the default lockup.

mark.$description: The portion dot beside the wordmark; decorative, no meaning of its own.

inverse.$description: Wordmark and dot on a dark or action-coloured surface.

accent.$description: Water fill, icon and figure marker. Distinct from action blue and the carbohydrate teal; 3:1+ on canvas and on the water track for the non-text fill.

surface.$description: Tinted surface behind the water quick-add control and icon.

track.$description: Unfilled part of the water track.

text.$description: Water status text and the quick-add label; 4.5:1+ on canvas, surface and the water surface.

stage.$description: The dark viewfinder surface of the barcode and photo steps — the only dark surface in the product.

stage-text.$description: Guidance and chip text on the stage.

chip-surface.$description: Translucent status-chip fill on the stage.

frame.$description: Focus corners and framing guide while scanning or framing.

detected.$description: Corners, chip and scan-stop treatment once a code is read: light blue for 3:1+ on the stage, paired with wording.

chip-surface-on-image.$description: Status-chip fill over a captured frame: the stage colour at 72 % so white text stays readable on any photograph.

main-result.$description: One main calculated calorie value in a result composition. 40/48, 600.

screen-heading.$description: Root screen title: Home, Search, Recipes. 28/36, 600.

detail-heading.$description: Full food or recipe title in details or review. 24/32, 600.

section-title.$description: Nutrition, Ingredients, Instructions; sheet and dialog titles. 20/28, 600.

compact-title.$description: Top app bar title, recipe-card title, empty-state title. 18/24, 600.

action-md.$description: Medium (default) button label and the unit selector; prominent list-row titles and inline metrics through aliases. 16/24, 600.

body.$description: Reading text; input, textarea and search values. 16/24, 400.

label.$description: Field and group labels; filter chip labels. 14/20, 500.

supporting.$description: Helper and error text, context, secondary descriptions. 14/20, 400.

action-sm.$description: Small button label for in-context actions (Filters, Reset all, Show all nutrition, Clear) and the selected segment of a segmented control. 14/20, 600.

caption.$description: Short static tags, count badges' companions and incidental metadata. 12/16, 500. The floor for content text: the only smaller role is nav-label-active (10/14, 700), restricted to the active bottom-navigation label.

caption-strong.$description: Selected bottom-navigation label; compact count badge. 12/16, 600.

nav-label-active.$description: The visible label of the active bottom-navigation destination beside its bold glyph. 10/14, 700. The only role below 12 px; never used for content.

action-lg.$description: Alias: large button label. Same 16/24, 600 as action-md; the large size differs by geometry (56 px control, 24 px inline padding), not by type.

control-label.$description: Alias: the persistent label of a form control (FormField), 14/20, 500.

segmented-label.$description: Alias: an unselected segment of a segmented control, 14/20, 500.

segmented-label-selected.$description: Alias: the selected segment of a segmented control, 14/20, 600 — same metrics as segmented-label so selection never reflows the track.

item-title.$description: Alias: food search-result row title and photo suggestion name.

metric-inline.$description: Alias: compact calorie or nutrient value in a row; pair with the numeric modifier.

metric-secondary.$description: Alias: macro value in a nutrition summary (20/28) — one clear step below the 40/48 main result and above inline metrics; not an HTML heading.

wordmark.$description: Lowercase 'portion' wordmark in a header. 24/32, 600, -0.03em tracking, isolated to the wordmark.

wordmark-compact.$description: Compact lockup, 18/24 with the wordmark's tracking, for tight rows; the default lockup stays 24/32.

page-inset.$description: Mobile page inset; safe-area padding is additional.

card-gap.$description: Between card-shaped items in a vertical list, e.g. RecipeCard. Distinct from card-padding, a card's own internal inset.

structure.$description: Full-bleed structural regions only (viewfinder, media breakouts, bars). Never the authored corner of an independent component surface.

control-compact.$description: Elements nested inside another control, or non-interactive tags: segmented-control segments (track 8 minus 4 padding), badges, category markers.

control.$description: Interactive controls and inline notices: buttons, inputs, search field, chips, the segmented-control track, inline messages, the Add food glyph.

card.$description: Independent content cards and tiles: recipe card, entry-method tile, logged-entry row, media thumbnails.

grouped.$description: Grouped surfaces that hold a whole section: Home's daily-overview group, prototype-control groups.

sheet.$description: Top corners of bottom sheets and every corner of a centred dialog.

navigation-group.$description: The compact destination group of the bottom navigation — the grouped step, chosen after rendering 12 and 16 (12 read as a card, 16 as a container; neither is a capsule).

navigation-item.$description: The active destination's contained surface inside the group (16 minus the 4 px padding keeps the corners concentric).

round.$description: True circles only: the Log food action, radio marks, step-number discs, the progress ring's arc caps.

navigation.$description: Restrained elevation under the fixed bottom navigation, replacing its former top border.

press.$description: Button press and release surface change.

disclosure.$description: Expand and collapse of secondary content.

async-result.$description: Result region replacing a pending state.

value-change.$description: A numeric figure and its fill moving from the previous to the new total (water quick add).

scan-sweep.$description: One pass of the barcode scan line; loops only while scanning.
